name: simple-claude
label: Simple Claude
vibe: Calm editorial confidence. Flat cards, warm paper, one accent. The graphic never shouts; the words do the work.

motion.notes: Minimal. Fades and small rises only. No bounce, no glow, no overshoot. Stillness is the brand; rest motion is none.

componentAccents.textOnScreen: compact slim white pill, small bold ink text, single line, bottom-center
componentAccents.ctaBanner: white pill, ink text, small icon
componentAccents.subscribe: YouTube red button (functional color, overrides accent) + flat bell chip, cursor click animation
componentAccents.conceptSplitPanel: flat warm ivory full-height side panel with a hard vertical edge, eyebrow dot label, flat list rows with accent strike or check marks
componentAccents.concept75Field: warm paper field with a soft accent wash, footage in a rounded card with subtle shadow, large flat rows
componentAccents.conceptFullScreen: flat card row over the fullscreenBackground, accent line icons, editorial spacing

fullscreenBackground: warm ivory paper texture, soft grain, gentle terracotta-tinted wash from one corner, calm and flat
